answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the nadir record and indexed in the inlet history, the ivory audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Filling 80 aliases therefore needs 80 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
